learning: Track width at y 0.08 has been monotone so far (0.10: 496.4, 0.12: 561.6, 0.14: 628.6). The controller has needed no fix beyond the fixed kp 4.0. Whether a wider track needs a higher kp is untested, so it stays fixed for this race.
notes: Iteration 8 package: the Builder's wheel_track 0.16 geometry at sensor y 0.08, with the iteration 7 controller unchanged, so only track width differs from the 628.6 best.
rationale: Iteration 7 (wheel_track 0.14, y 0.08, kp 4.0) is the best design so far at 628.6. Across the track-width sweep at y 0.08, the score moved 496.4 (0.10), 561.6 (0.12), 628.6 (0.14), and the s-bend off-track exits fell 15, 9, 4 of 20. The narrower direction overshot in bends, so the monotone trend favours a wider track. The Builder's proposal is wheel_track 0.16 with everything else unchanged, so I keep the iteration 7 controller unchanged (kp 4.0, ki 0.1, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], last_direction). This keeps the race a one-variable test of track width. I considered raising kp to offset the lower yaw per command at a wider track, but iteration 2 showed that a gain change without evidence can hurt, so I leave kp for a later step if max_error rises. Oscillation was 0.19 on the oval and 0.32 on the s-bend at 0.14, both under the 0.4 gate, so there is margin. Slalom has stayed at 0 of 20 at every geometry tested, so this race is not aimed at it. I make no claim about the result of this package.
